versions.changelog: Security and metadata improvements: (1) Declared UF2_API_KEY as required credential in frontmatter metadata, (2) Added comprehensive credential management section with secure storage recommendations, (3) Removed references to storing keys in plain text files, (4) Added service details (homepage, TLS, docs), (5) Added security notes section documenting link visibility and constraints, (6) Added source/homepage metadata fields. Addresses registry security review feedback.
Initial release: Create, manage, and track short URLs via uf2.net API. Includes CLI wrapper, full API docs, and tracking support.
